name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: The CSF 2.0 Core outcomes Paddock can evidence: asset management, risk assessment, platform security and continuous monitoring. Govern (GV) outcomes are organisational.

controls.title: Suppliers are known and prioritised by criticality
controls.summary: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality.
controls.rationale: Supplier management is organisational; Paddock's SBOM lists third-party components, not suppliers.
controls.attestation: Provide the supplier inventory and criticality ranking.

controls.title: Hardware inventories are maintained
controls.summary: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained.
controls.rationale: External discovery plus Sentry's passive device inventory (IoT/OT) keep the hardware view current.

controls.title: Software, services and systems inventories are maintained
controls.summary: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained.
controls.rationale: SBOM per project, plus discovered services and technologies on the external surface.

controls.title: Network communication and data flows are represented
controls.summary: Representations of authorized network communication and network data flows are maintained.
controls.rationale: Sentry records observed flows between segments; whether they are authorised is decided by the organisation.
controls.attestation: Mark which observed flows are authorised.

controls.title: Assets are prioritised
controls.summary: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission.
controls.rationale: Classification labels and crown-jewel attack paths drive prioritisation; mission impact is organisational.

controls.title: Assets are managed through their life cycles
controls.summary: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles.
controls.rationale: First/last-seen tracking and change detection show assets appearing and disappearing; disposal processes are organisational.

controls.title: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated and recorded
controls.summary: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded.
controls.rationale: Continuous scanning and CVE/OSV matching record vulnerabilities with evidence and provenance.

controls.title: Cyber threat intelligence is received
controls.summary: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources.
controls.rationale: STIX/TAXII feeds and CISA KEV are ingested and matched to assets.

controls.title: Impacts and likelihoods are identified
controls.summary: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded.
controls.rationale: Attack paths estimate exploitability from foothold to crown jewel; EPSS/KEV inform likelihood.

controls.title: Risk informs response prioritisation
controls.summary: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization.
controls.rationale: Risk-ranked findings are routed to owners; the risk appetite that sets priorities is organisational.

controls.title: Risk responses are chosen, tracked and communicated
controls.summary: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated.
controls.rationale: Tickets with owners and SLA clocks track each response; risk acceptance is recorded per finding.

controls.title: Vulnerability disclosure handling is established
controls.summary: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established.
controls.rationale: A disclosure intake process is organisational.
controls.attestation: Provide the vulnerability disclosure policy and intake records.

controls.title: Authenticity and integrity of software is assessed
controls.summary: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use.
controls.rationale: Supply-chain checks (known-vulnerable and typosquatted packages) cover open-source components only.

controls.title: Data in transit is protected
controls.summary: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected.
controls.rationale: TLS grading and cleartext detection cover observed endpoints and segments only.

controls.title: Configuration management practices are applied
controls.summary: Configuration management practices are established and applied.
controls.rationale: Policy-as-code and header/TLS checks verify outcomes of configuration management on the surface.

controls.title: Software is maintained commensurate with risk
controls.summary: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk.
controls.rationale: Vulnerable components and outdated services are tracked to remediation.

controls.title: Log records are generated for continuous monitoring
controls.summary: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring.
controls.rationale: Paddock's own audit log only; enterprise logging is out of scope.

controls.title: Secure software development practices are integrated
controls.summary: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle.
controls.rationale: SAST and secret scanning are monitored; the wider SDLC is organisational.

controls.title: Networks are protected from unauthorised logical access
controls.summary: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage.
controls.rationale: Observed segment crossings, OT exposure and unnecessary internet exposure are tracked as findings.

controls.title: Networks and network services are monitored
controls.summary: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
controls.rationale: Sentry monitors mirrored segments; scheduled scans and change detection monitor the external surface.

controls.title: Computing hardware and software are monitored
controls.summary: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events.
controls.rationale: Fleet agents report inventory and posture; this is not EDR.

controls.title: Threat intelligence is integrated into analysis
controls.summary: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis.
controls.rationale: Indicators are matched against assets and findings.

controls.title: Incident response plan is executed
controls.summary: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared.
controls.rationale: Organisational.
controls.attestation: Provide the incident response plan and records.
